extension.dc:title: Chronometric Age
extension.name: ChronometricAge
extension.dc:subject: dwc:Event dwc:Occurrence
extension.dc:description: Extended support for Darwin Core Events or Occurrences related to chronometric ages.

property.name: chronometricAgeID
property.label: Chronometric Age ID
property.dc:description: An identifier for the set of information associated with a chrono:ChronometricAge.
property.comments: May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the dataset. This can be used to link this record to another repository where more information about the dataset is shared.

property.name: verbatimChronometricAge
property.label: Verbatim Chronometric Age
property.dc:description: The verbatim age for a specimen, whether reported by a dating assay, associated references, or legacy information.
property.comments: For example, this could be the radiocarbon age as given in an AMS dating report. This could also be simply what is reported as the age of a specimen in legacy collections data.

property.name: chronometricAgeProtocol
property.label: Chronometric Age Protocol
property.dc:description: A description of or reference to the methods used to determine the chrono:ChronometricAge.
property.comments: This term has an equivalent in the chronoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
property.examples: `radiocarbon AMS`; `K-Ar dates for the lower most marker tuff`; `historic documentation`; `ceramic seriation`

property.name: uncalibratedChronometricAge
property.label: Uncalibrated Chronometric Age
property.dc:description: The output of a dating assay before it is calibrated into an age using a specific conversion protocol.

property.name: chronometricAgeConversionProtocol
property.label: Chronometric Age Conversion Protocol
property.dc:description: The method used for converting the chrono:uncalibratedChronometricAge into a chronometric age in years, as captured in the chrono:earliestChronometricAge, chrono:earliestChronometricAgeReferenceSystem, chrono:latestChronometricAge, and chrono:latestChronometricAgeReferenceSystem fields.
property.comments: For example, calibration of conventional radiocarbon age or the currently accepted age range of a cultural or geological period. This term has an equivalent in the chronoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
property.examples: `INTCAL13`; `sequential 6 phase Bayesian model and IntCal13 calibration`

property.name: earliestChronometricAge
property.label: Earliest Chronometric Age
property.dc:description: The maximum/earliest/oldest possible age of a specimen as determined by a dating method.
property.comments: The expected unit for this field is years. This field, if populated, must have an associated chrono:earliestChronometricAgeReferenceSystem.

property.name: earliestChronometricAgeReferenceSystem
property.label: Earliest Chronometric Age Reference System
property.dc:description: The reference system associated with the chrono:earliestChronometricAge.
property.comments: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. This term has an equivalent in the chronoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.

property.name: latestChronometricAge
property.label: Latest Chronometric Age
property.dc:description: The minimum/latest/youngest possible age of a specimen as determined by a dating method.
property.comments: The expected unit for this field is years. This field, if populated, must have an associated chrono:latestChronometricAgeReferenceSystem.

property.name: latestChronometricAgeReferenceSystem
property.label: Latest Chronometric Age Reference System
property.dc:description: The reference system associated with the chrono:latestChronometricAge.
property.comments: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. This term has an equivalent in the chronoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.

property.name: chronometricAgeUncertaintyInYears
property.label: Chronometric Age Uncertainty In Years
property.dc:description: The temporal uncertainty of the chrono:earliestChronometricAge and chrono:latestChronometricAge in years.
property.comments: The expected unit for this field is years. The value in this field is number of years before and after the values given in the chrono:earliestChronometricAge and chrono:latestChronometricAge fields within which the actual values are estimated to be.

property.name: chronometricAgeUncertaintyMethod
property.label: Chronometric Age Uncertainty Method
property.dc:description: The method used to generate the value of chrono:chronometricAgeUncertaintyInYears.
property.comments: This term has an equivalent in the chronoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.

property.name: materialDated
property.label: Material Dated
property.dc:description: A description of the material on which the chrono:chronometricAgeProtocol was actually performed, if known.
property.comments: This term has an equivalent in the chronoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
property.examples: `Double Tuff`; `Charcoal found in Stratum V`; `charred wood`; `tooth`

property.name: materialDatedID
property.label: Material Dated ID
property.dc:description: An identifier for the dwc:MaterialEntity on which the chrono:chronometricAgeProtocol was performed, if applicable.

property.name: materialDatedRelationship
property.label: Material Dated Relationship
property.dc:description: The relationship of the chrono:materialDated to the subject of the chrono:ChronometricAge record, from which the chrono:ChronometricAge of the subject is inferred.
property.comments: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary.
property.examples: `sameAs` (cases where the subject material was completely destructively subsampled to get the ChronometricAge); `subsampleOf` (cases where part of the original specimen was extracted as the material used to determine the ChronometricAge); `inContextWith` (cases where the ChronometricAge is inferred from materialDated, such as sediments or cultural objects, in related temporal context); `stratigraphicallyCorrelatedWith` (cases where the ChronometricAge is inferred from materialDated in a stratigraphically correlated context)

property.name: chronometricAgeDeterminedBy
property.label: Chronometric Age Determined By
property.dc:description: A list (concatenated and separated) of names of people, groups, or organizations who determined the chrono:ChronometricAge.
property.comments: Recommended best practice is to separate the values in a list with space vertical bar space ( | ). This term has an equivalent in the chronoiri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.

property.name: chronometricAgeDeterminedDate
property.label: Chronometric Age Determined Date
property.dc:description: The date on which the chrono:ChronometricAge was determined.
property.comments: Recommended best practice is to use a date that conforms to ISO 8601-1:2019.
property.examples: `1963-03-08T14:07-0600` (8 Mar 1963 at 2:07pm in the time zone six hours earlier than UTC); `2009-02-20T08:40Z` (20 February 2009 8:40am UTC); `2018-08-29T15:19` (3:19pm local time on 29 August 2018); `1809-02-12` (some time during 12 February 1809); `1906-06` (some time in June 1906); `1971` (some time in the year 1971)

property.name: chronometricAgeReferences
property.label: Chronometric Age References
property.dc:description: A list (concatenated and separated) of identifiers (publication, bibliographic reference, global unique identifier, URI) of literature associated with the chrono:ChronometricAge.
property.comments: Recommended best practice is to separate the values in a list with space vertical bar space ( | ).
property.examples: `Pluckhahn, Thomas J., Neill J. Wallis, and Victor D. Thompson. 2020 The History and Future of Migrationist Explanation in the Archaeology of the Eastern Woodlands: A Review and Case Study of the Woodland Period Gulf Coast. Journal of Archaeological Research. https://doi.org/10.1007/s10814-019-09140-x`

property.name: chronometricAgeRemarks
property.label: Chronometric Age Remarks
property.dc:description: Notes or comments about the chrono:ChronometricAge.
property.examples: `Beta Analytic number: 323913 | One of the Crassostrea virginica right valve specimens from North Midden Feature 17 was chosen for AMS dating, but it is unclear exactly which specimen it was.`
